Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Your offer cites index movements and their shares of your costs and excludes a price-adjustment clause. Please provide your cost breakdown in XLSX format; we require a lower price based on scrutiny of the individual components and actual cost changes, not index movements alone.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 36 months, 284400 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 4.55 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 36-month contract; option B: EUR 4.49 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 45 days net, 36-month contract; option C: EUR 4.46 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 36-month contract. Option A amounts to about EUR 1294020 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per unit for this part; your new quote is 11.0% above it. Beyond this part, we buy Sheet 1.4301 2 mm, 2B, cut to size from another supplier today, in a volume close to this bar's, and you have quoted it for us before. Once this agreement is signed, we will invite you to quote for it. Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

You have revised your offer after validating the index and volume data and require an alloy-index clause for the proposed contract term. We require a lower base price in exchange for accepting that clause, with a defined deadband and adjustments taking effect only when index movements affect your actual costs.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 36 months, 284400 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 4.72 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 36-month contract. This amounts to about EUR 1342368 over the term.
3. Basis: Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
